City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 15, 2019 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of Proclamation for National Public Works Week
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the April 17, 2019 Special Joint Meeting-Closed Session, April 17, 2019 Regular Meeting, April 24, 2019 Special Joint Meeting-Closed Session and April 24, 2019 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.

8B.
National Fish and Wildlife Foundation (NFWF) sponsored grant, appropriated by the National Coastal Resilience Fund 2019. Contact Person: Coastal Zone Program Administrator Timberlake
Authorize staff to submit a pre-proposal application for the National Coastal Resilience Fund 2019, Request for Proposals.
2019-05-15 Item 08B Coastal Resilience Fund
8C.
Authorization to Purchase Fleet Vehicles and Equipment Due for Replacement in Fiscal Year 2018-19. Contact Person: Management Analyst Stratakis
1) Authorize the purchase of three vehicles from National Joint Powers Alliance (NJPA) in accordance with the attached quotes, for an amount not-to-exceed $110,000, plus up-fit costs not to exceed $9,500, for a total amount of $119,500 to cover vehicle purchases in Fiscal Year 2018-19; and 2) Authorize the purchase of three pieces of equipment in accordance with the attached quotes, for an amount not-to-exceed $232,100, plus up-fit costs not to exceed $15,600, for a total amount of $247,700 to cover equipment purchases in Fiscal Year 2018-19.
2019-05-15 Item 08C Fleet and Vehicle Replacement FY18-19
9.

10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Council to hear from applicants and consider the appointment of two Tenant Commissioners to the Housing Authority. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
1) Hear each applicant briefly explain his/her qualifications and interest in serving as a Tenant Commissioner to the Housing Authority; 2) discuss as needed; and 3) the Mayor, with approval from the City Council, appoints two Tenant Commissioners to the Housing Authority with terms ending June 2021 or defer the appointment to the May 22, 2019, City Council meeting.

Discussion of School Crossing Guard Pilot Program. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Provide direction to staff to work with the Encinitas Union School District and San Dieguito Union High School District regarding the development of a School Crossing Guard Pilot Program.
2019-05-15 Item 10C Crossing Guard Pilot Program

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
